title: 第一部分 基础训练 TEST 6

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
There was a special birthday party at Chongqing Zoo on September 13, 2023 for twin pandas Xiong Xiaokai and Mao Xiaoyu. The twin pandas turned two years old.

The zoo invited(邀请) their roommates—another twin panda brothers Xingxing and Chenchen, as special guests (客人). Over a thousand people also came to join the party. Four pandas enjoyed the birthday cake made from bamboo, with strawberries and grapes, outside their room.

The two-year-old twin pandas' mom is Haoqi at the local zoo, and their dad is Lulin, who lives in the China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda(中国大熊猫保护研究中心).

The workers in the zoo filmed the twin pandas' interesting birthday party and shared the video online. Many people have watched it.

questions.prompt: When were Xiong Xiaokai and Mao Xiaoyu born?
questions.translation: 熊晓恺和猫晓峪是什么时候出生的？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“September 13, 2023 for twin pandas... The twin pandas turned two years old.”可知，2023年9月满两周岁，因此出生年份为 2023 - 2 = 2021年。答案为B。

questions.prompt: How many pandas shared the birthday cake?
questions.translation: 共有几只大熊猫分享了生日蛋糕？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Four pandas enjoyed the birthday cake made from bamboo...”可知，共有4只熊猫一起享用了生日蛋糕。答案为C。

questions.prompt: Who is Xiong Xiaokai and Mao Xiaoyu's father?
questions.translation: 熊晓恺和猫晓峪的父亲是谁？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“and their dad is Lulin, who lives in...”可知，它们的爸爸是芦林（Lulin）。答案为D。

questions.prompt: Which part of a magazine may this passage come from?
questions.translation: 这篇文章可能来自杂志的哪个版块？
questions.explanation: 整篇文章讲述重庆动物园双胞胎大熊猫过生日的趣事，最可能出自“动物世界（Animal World）”版块。答案为A。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
51-year-old Tim Shaddock and his dog Bella drifted(漂流) at sea for over two months. Luckily, a fishing boat found and saved them.

Mr Shaddock is an Australian fisherman. He and his dog left La Paz in Mexico in April. He made his way to French Polynesia by boat. Unluckily, one month after he left La Paz, his boat's equipment(设备) stopped working because of the bad weather and he got lost at sea. What's worse, Mr Shaddock couldn't get in touch with the outside world. He and his dog were stranded (滞留) in the middle of the Pacific Ocean.

Mr Shaddock had a hard time at sea. He didn't have enough food or water. The pair lived on rainwater and fish. After being saved, the pair were sent back to Mexico, where Mr Shaddock received medical care(医疗护理). Now, he is in good health, and Bella, his good friend, also looks better.

questions.prompt: How long did Mr Shaddock drift at sea before he was saved?
questions.translation: 沙多克先生在获救前在海上漂流了多久？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“drifted at sea for over two months”可知，在海上漂流了两个多月。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Where did Mr Shaddock start his trip at sea?
questions.translation: 沙多克先生是在哪里开始他的海上之旅的？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“He and his dog left La Paz in Mexico in April.”可知，是从墨西哥的拉巴斯（La Paz）出发的。答案为A。

questions.prompt:
Why was Mr Shaddock stranded in the middle of the Pacific Ocean?
① The wind was too strong.
② He didn't have enough food or water.
③ He couldn't call for help from the outside world.
④ There was something wrong with his boat's equipment.
questions.translation:
为什么沙多克先生被困在太平洋中部？
①风太大。
②他没有足够的食物或水。
③他无法向外界求救。
④他的船只设备出了故障。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“his boat's equipment stopped working（设备损坏，④）... couldn't get in touch with the outside world（无法联系外界，③）”可知，答案为③④，即D。

questions.prompt: What did Mr Shaddock live on?
questions.translation: 沙多克先生靠什么维持生计？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“The pair lived on rainwater and fish.”可知，他们靠雨水和生鱼为生。答案为C。

questions.prompt: What can we know from the passage?
options: Mr Shaddock was sent back to Mexico.
The police found Mr Shaddock and his dog.
Mr Shaddock's dog is still in poor health.
questions.translation: 我们从文章中可以知道什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“After being saved, the pair were sent back to Mexico...”可知，沙多克先生和他的狗获救后被送回了墨西哥。答案为B。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 C
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Camels are called "the boats of the desert" by people. Here's some information about them.

There are two kinds of camels. The dromedary(单峰驼) is a camel with only one hump(驼峰). The Bactrian camel(双峰驼) is a camel with two humps.

Camels are usually 1.85 m at the shoulder (肩膀) and 2.15 m at the hump. Dromedaries weigh about 300 to 600 kg and Bactrian camels weigh about 800 kg.

Some people think there is a lot of water in camels' humps. In fact, their humps store (贮存) fat which can be turned into water or energy. They can survive (存活) for one month without food or water by using the fat in their humps. And a large camel can drink about 120 liters of water in just 13 minutes.

Camels have been living with humans for thousands of years. They can help people carry heavy things and people give them food and water.

questions.prompt: What are camels called by people?
questions.translation: 骆驼被人们称为什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第一段“Camels are called 'the boats of the desert' by people.”可知，骆驼被称为“沙漠之舟”。答案为D。

questions.prompt: Dromedaries weigh about ________.
questions.translation: 单峰驼的体重约为 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Dromedaries weigh about 300 to 600 kg...”可知，重约300到600千克。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Camels store ________ in their humps.
questions.translation: 骆驼在驼峰里储存 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“In fact, their humps store fat which can be turned into water or energy.”可知，驼峰里储存的是脂肪（fat）。答案为B。

questions.prompt: How long can camels survive without food and water?
questions.translation: 没有食物和水骆驼能存活多久？
questions.explanation: 根据第四段“They can survive for one month without food or water...”可知，能存活一个月（For one month）。答案为C。

questions.prompt: From the text, we can know ________.
options: how much food camels eat every day
how camels take care of their babies
how far camels can walk in a day
how long camels have been living with people
questions.translation: 从文中我们可以知道 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据最后一段“Camels have been living with humans for thousands of years.”可知，我们能知道骆驼与人类共同生活了多久。答案为D。

sections.title: 一、阅读理解 D
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
There are often all kinds of funny things happening in our class. We met one today and had a good laugh.

Mr Smith, our history teacher, was teaching the class while Jason was talking too much. Mr Smith said, "Be quiet, please." But it was no use.

Then he said, "I have a question. When do people talk least(最少)?"

No one could answer it. Mr Smith called Jason. Jason stood there and didn't know how to answer it. After a while, he had an idea. "In February, sir."

"Why?" All of us were very <u>confused</u>.

"Because February is the shortest month of a year." Everybody broke into a big laugh.

Mr Smith said with a smile, "I know. You talk so much because it's February. You want to make it the same as the other months, right?"

All the students laughed again. Jason's face turned red. "Sorry, sir. I won't do that again."

"That's the boy! Let's get back to our lesson," said Mr Smith.

questions.prompt: The funny thing happened ________.
questions.translation: 这件趣事发生在 ________。
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Mr Smith, our history teacher, was teaching the class...”可知，发生在课堂上（in class）。答案为D。

questions.prompt: What does the underlined word "confused" mean?
questions.translation: 画线单词“confused”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: 老师问人们什么时候说话最少，杰森回答“二月份”，大家不知道为什么，感到很困惑、不解。因此confused意为“困惑的”。答案为B。

questions.prompt: Why did Jason answer that people talk least in February?
options: Because people don't like talking in February.
Because February is shorter than other months.
Because he didn't know how to answer Mr Smith's question.
questions.translation: 杰森为什么回答人们在二月说话最少？
questions.explanation: 根据杰森的回答“Because February is the shortest month of a year.”可知，因为二月份天数最少、比其他月份都短。答案为C。

questions.prompt: From the passage, we know Jason is ________.
questions.translation: 从文章中我们知道杰森是 ________ 的。
questions.explanation: 面对老师的提问，杰森巧妙机智地联想到二月天数最少并给出了幽默的回答，说明他很聪明机智（smart）。答案为A。

questions.prompt: Why did Jason's face turn red?
options: Because he knew he did something wrong.
Because all the students laughed at him.
Because his face turned red easily.
questions.translation: 杰森为什么脸红了？
questions.explanation: 老师指出他上课一直在说话，杰森感到不好意思并道歉“Sorry, sir. I won't do that again”，说明他意识到自己做错了。答案为A。

sections.title: 二、任务型阅读
sections.instruction: 阅读下面语言材料，从每题所给的 A、B、C、D 四个选项中选出最佳选项。
sections.passage:
Ambrose became a hero (英雄) in his neighborhood. But he said, "I just did what I should do."

Ambrose Younge is a bus driver. One day, when he was at the end of his route(路线), he saw a little boy walking in a heavy snow. The boy looked lonely and wore a schoolbag. Ambrose knew schools were closed because of the bad weather that day. So he was worried about the boy and wanted to know what was happening.

Ambrose asked where his family was and what his parents' phone numbers were. But the little boy didn't answer him. Ambrose tried to ask the boy to get on the bus and called the police. Then they found out that the boy had autism(自闭症). The police found the boy's family.

Thanks to Ambrose and the police, the boy was reunited(重聚) with his family.

questions.prompt: How was the weather when Ambrose saw the little boy?
questions.translation: 当安布罗斯看到小男孩时天气怎么样？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“he saw a little boy walking in a heavy snow... bad weather that day”可知，当时下着大雪。答案为C。

questions.prompt: Why were schools closed that day?
questions.translation: 那天学校为什么停课？
questions.explanation: 根据第二段“Ambrose knew schools were closed because of the bad weather that day.”可知，是因为糟糕的天气。答案为B。

questions.prompt: What did Ambrose ask the little boy?
options: Where his school was and what grade he was in.
What his name was and why he missed the bus.
Where his family was and what his parents' phone numbers were.
Whether he wanted some hot food and water.
questions.translation: 安布罗斯问了那个小男孩什么？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段“Ambrose asked where his family was and what his parents' phone numbers were.”可知，问了家人在哪里以及父母的电话号码。答案为C。

questions.prompt: Who found the boy's family finally?
options: A kind passenger on the bus.
questions.translation: 最后是谁找到了男孩的家人？
questions.explanation: 根据第三段最后一句“The police found the boy's family.”可知，是警察找到了男孩的家人。答案为A。

questions.prompt: What can we learn about Ambrose from the passage?
options: He was a strict police officer.
He was a kind, helpful and responsible bus driver.
He only cared about his own bus schedule.
questions.translation: 从短文中我们可以了解到安布罗斯是个怎样的人？
questions.explanation: 根据短文安布罗斯热心救助自闭症男孩并报警使其与家人团聚，可知他是一位善良、乐于助人且负责任的公交司机。答案为B。
